stage: Frozen repaired V35 candidate: identity-corrected October03–11 prediction gate

validation.endpoint_panel: Known REAL endpoints at scheduled-300 with actual>cutoff, including endpoints without a numeric message; score the common physical trip posterior.
validation.onboard_panel: Every supported contiguous pair of same-vehicle connections with measured chronological endpoints. At first-leg arrival, reveal that leg's departure and arrival and only messages already received; predict the next leg's arrival. Selection uses topology and label coverage, not error or method advantage.
validation.aggregation: Retain every row, unsupported history and date. Report date means and equal-date macro means on common supported queries; no independent-endpoint confidence intervals.
validation.model_retention_gate: No increased unsupported queries; onboard macro CRPS strictly below legacy and no worse than own_only; onboard Brier no worse than legacy; onboard 90% coverage absolute deviation from 0.90 no worse than legacy. This is a development retention rule, not G2.

information: Local raw archives; V34 extractor, 600-second sampling, 07:00 to 09:40; availability=max(capture,header,TripUpdate timestamp). No actual label substitutes for a prediction.
physical_model: Unchanged V35 validation operator: V5 physical fit, minute=60, public_occurrences=False, original graph, exact own first-leg observations, latest endpoint messages. Both message arms consume the same corrected frames.
baselines: own_only: original physical law with own observations
legacy_messages: original unfitted MessageHistory likelihood, on corrected messages; this is not the old V35 334-sample fitted model
identity_matching: training_identity_v1.audit: exact full-day public endpoint and unique active physical service; retain every original query and unresolved correspondence, no literal-ID fallback
version_selection: Official/mirror metadata and collector getValidUntil; selected before RT reconstruction or new scores; see static_source_manifest.json

gate_expressions.no_increased_unsupported_in_each_panel: fitted unsupported <= legacy unsupported, separately for endpoint and onboard panels

after_gate: Assess whether same-information control and strong-cheap-baseline pairing is warranted only after all nine days and the unchanged gate. Failure keeps the candidate diagnostic and unpromoted; no retuning, search or DP. Success is development retention only, not G2 or independent confirmation.
preserved: all original validation queries, labels and clocks
all positive, negative, unsupported and missing cases
data_status: Previously developed retrospective dates, disjoint from V34 six-date decision panel; not pristine confirmation.
